$comment: Declared human-gate controls for this repository. The source of truth the preflight verifier (templates/release/verify-gates.mjs) checks the LIVE GitHub state against, fail-closed. Authorization decisions reference the verifier's output, not this file's existence. Phase 13 C1.

pull_request.$note: C2/C3 trust root is this reviewed, no-self-approval, no-bypass merge (min_approvals + require_last_push_approval + no bypass_actors, all live). Code-owner review is a foundation recommendation for multi-maintainer repos; it is inert in this single-human instance until CODEOWNERS is present on main, so it is not asserted as a hard gate here.
